_meta.purpose: Version stamp and release notes, shown in the what changed sheet.
_meta.note: The version must mirror index.html's app-version meta tag; verify.mjs enforces it.

releases.head: A new map
changes: The map is now the whole tool: it is the home screen, it answers every subject you tap in Plan, it grows as you play, and it is the card you keep at the end.
The back button works everywhere, and a reload puts you back where you were.
First visit asks your year and your guess once, then never again.
The rulebook now arrives in three steps: a plain word, a plain sentence, and the exact rule with its source behind one fold.
Money, work and your school now appear where they matter, not only as pages.
One face for the words on every phone, and dark mode is a proper night.
